methods.s1: Q-mapped IA_TimeAbility and movement injected through Enhanced Input; actual conversations, ability mode, rock motion and energy observed. Native short keypress was not a reliable automation stimulus.
methods.targets: Production equipped pistol BeginFire; unchanged default spread 0.5 in cold tests. Explicit stage entry and aim/position fixtures. Body rejection, weakpoint hits, movement, animation and FullStop observed.
methods.rock: Actual link shot and falling-rock landing; one real NPC placed beneath footprint and another outside, AI stopped for deterministic damage observation.
methods.death: Two actual player damage events (player health accepts one point per event), separated by 1.5 real seconds, after spending energy and reducing pistol ammunition. No health/energy setter used.
methods.completion: Remaining real NPCs killed with injected damage to verify the stage completion transition.

formatting: Initial 121 graphs and follow-up 62 controller graphs compared; no functional changes caused by formatting.
voice: New activation/Q instruction is text-only; existing follow-up voice retained.
scope_limit: Scoped cold tests, not a continuous full S1-to-finish playthrough; original engine animation/navigation warnings are not represented as Blueprint compiler errors.

arena_ai_smoke.methods: Invulnerable player placed in the arena; production NPC brains restarted after deterministic fixture tests. Health damage was not asserted in this observation.
